hypotheses.hypothesis: Foundation-model errors are more correlated with each other than classical-model errors.
The correlation gap is larger in stress than in calm periods.
hypotheses.note: Insufficient stress: the pre-registered minimum of stress days and episodes is not met.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The ensemble's diversification benefit is smaller in stress than in calm periods.
hypotheses.note: Insufficient stress: the pre-registered minimum of stress days and episodes is not met.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The equal-weight foundation ensemble beats each of its three members.

conclusion: Foundation-model errors are more correlated than classical-model errors. Whether stress changes this cannot be concluded.
Ensembling the three foundation models does not reliably beat its members.
Stress minimum not met: H2 and H3 are inconclusive because of insufficient stress. H1 and H4 are reported.
